actions.name: curve forward, left wheel 0 %, right 30 % (curves left)
curve forward, left wheel 30 %, right 0 % (curves right)

control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 (dim light): if line tracker < 40 (black) curve left; else if > 88 (white) curve right; else nothing. If bright (70 or more): nothing.
avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called, so they never run.

uncertainties: Only followInTheDark is called: avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never run, so the robot can't avoid or stop at walls.
In bright light the robot does nothing, so it only moves if it starts inside a tunnel.
The curves use one wheel at 0 and one at 30, so the robot turns very sharply (about 87°/s) and may make little forward progress.
The robot only starts moving from inside a tunnel: to reach the dark line it must already begin there.
